original.evidence: Plans/Contracts_V0.md:867–868 makes visibility_level the closed enum user_visible/project/restricted, attention_level the closed enum info/warning/needs_action, and says “`chatworthy` is a boolean”. blocking_effect_ref is a required nullable pmref, distinct from severity. Both original_command and candidate_record in Plans/concern_created_contracts/concern_created_operation.schema.json:266–284 and 628–646 now enforce those same two enums. The durable record enforces them at Plans/concern_created_contracts/concern_record.schema.json:195–213. The storage registry copies match on the labels and field types. The closed stop_reason_code list runs from user_stopped through verification_terminal_failure, and budget_kind from wall_time through context_window (Plans/Contracts_V0.md:913–920). The minimum serialized example at line 302 uses “"severity":"error"” as DL-2602 answer 1 directs. That example and the settled operation fixture validate against their schemas. The repository's concern.created static check passed all 737 cases.

Plans/human-in-the-loop.md:2653 locates the file at “`<project root>/.puppet-master/PAUSE.md`”, specifies pause_id, scope, reason, created_by, created_at_utc, optional expires_at_utc and allowed_action_ids[], and says “Evaluate PAUSE first. For an action that passes PAUSE, evaluate any required HITL approval before dispatch.” Plans/orchestrator-subagent-integration.md:29203–29206 makes the check live. Its Pause Gate Live Contract at 35242–35247 says the Orchestrator reads the file “before dispatching each new execution-unit attempt” and “before admitting `cmd.orchestrator.resume`”. Scope is “`project` (every run in this project) or `run:<run_id>` (that run only)”. An allowed mutating action still needs any applicable HITL approval. An existing attempt may finish. An invalid file pauses project-wide with an empty allowlist. An in-scope halted run can resume after removal or expiry.

The deferred-action finding points to the same file as row 1501. Both Plans/human-in-the-loop.md:2653 and Plans/orchestrator-subagent-integration.md:35242 now say “`<project root>/.puppet-master/PAUSE.md`”. The latter adds “no other path is read”. OSI-387 specifies “This per-dispatch check is the live pause-gate watcher” (29204). The live contract gives the pre-attempt and resume admission checks, project/run scope, exact action allowlist, invalid-file handling and the clear condition “only when the file is removed or expires” (35243–35247). HITL gives the frontmatter fields and requires “any required HITL approval before dispatch” after the PAUSE check. The earlier Rust iteration snippet is no longer the sole watcher specification.
